mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.category, b.publisher, b.isbn, b.publish_year AS publishYear, b.description, b.cover, b.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS ratingCount FROM book b LEFT JOIN rating r ON b.id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.id DESC
SELECT id, title, author, category, publisher, isbn, publish_year AS publishYear, cover, create_time AS createTime FROM book
SELECT id, title, author, category, publisher, isbn, publish_year AS publishYear, cover, create_time AS createTime FROM book ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.category, b.publisher, b.isbn, b.publish_year AS publishYear, b.description, b.cover, b.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS ratingCount FROM book b LEFT JOIN rating r ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE b.id = #{id} GROUP BY b.id

SELECT id, title, author, category, publisher, isbn, publish_year AS publishYear, cover, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 10
